text: At least 11 commercial ships have been attacked in the Strait of Hormuz since early October, including a tanker hit by multiple projectiles off Qatar on Oct 8. Iran has signaled a full blockade.

judge.comment: Figures and events match tracker entries dated Oct 8 and Oct 10; neutral, data-first phrasing.

factChecks.claim: At least 11 commercial ships attacked in Hormuz since early October
Tanker hit by multiple projectiles off Qatar on Oct 8
Iran has signaled a full blockade

text: The EU says the Trump-Russia diesel import deal "funds" Russia's war on Ukraine and undermines the Western sanctions coalition. Zelensky protested the agreement when it was announced on Oct 10.

judge.comment: Attributed to the EU and Zelensky, matches two Oct 10 tracker events; no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: EU says the deal 'funds' Russia's war and undermines the sanctions coalition
Zelensky protested the agreement announced Oct 10

text: Has the DRC Ebola outbreak peaked? On 15 Sep, DRC's health minister said daily deaths fell from ~50 to ~30. The same day, the UN's Ebola coordinator said it "remains a deadly and a massive epidemic" still growing in some areas.

judge.comment: Both positions attributed with date, taken from the tracker's unresolved-dispute entry; no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: DRC health minister said on 15 Sep daily deaths fell from ~50 to ~30
UN coordinator said 'it remains a deadly and a massive epidemic' the same day

text: Saudi Arabia and the Houthis exchanged strikes on both capitals' airports. Riyadh confirmed 3 killed in the Houthi strike on its airport on Oct 9; the airport has reopened. The UN, UK and Arab states issued a joint condemnation.

judge.comment: All claims match Oct 9-10 tracker events; the death toll is attributed to Saudi confirmation.

Saudi Arabia confirmed 3 killed at Riyadh airport on Oct 9; airport reopened
